steps.what: File policies that already have a stored review date.
Develop engineering standards and technical procedures.
Implement only the policy version the manager accepted.

tasks.design: Policies that already have a review date are filed in {DOCS}. The manager develops the engineering standard and the technical procedure, and implements only the version already accepted. A policy with no review date is not filed. The index does not write the standard.
tasks.previous_blocker: Standards were copied forward and the review date was the date of the copy.
tasks.enabler_now: A policy that already has a review date can be filed before the manager writes the next standard.
tasks.still_hard: A technical procedure the old policy does not cover.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can see a current review date on a standard the work has outgrown.
tasks.altitude: Policies with a review date can be filed. The manager still develops the standard and still decides what to implement.

reach.task: File a policy that already has a review date, and still leave the standard with the manager.
reach.learn: The index can be shared. The standard stays here.

evidence.claim: A policy that already has a review date can be filed. The index cannot develop the engineering standard or the procedure.
The manager accepts the version that is implemented. The index does not put a standard into force.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural and engineering manager in a mid-size European firm. A list does not approve a design, place a person, or issue a contract.

Fields: Policy id and review date, produced by the policy file. A policy with no review date is not filed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the policy file the firm already keeps. Do not implement a standard from the index.
unknowns: Which policies already have a review date.
Who may put a standard into use on a project.
research_questions: What share of policies have a stored review date?
Which standards are written with no prior policy?

already_counted.description: The manager still develops the standard.
The manager still decides what to implement.

incremental.description: The manager writes a policy the file did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is filing policies that already have a review date. It disappears when the date is missing and the manager writes the policy. Developing and implementing the standard stays with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List broad outlines top management already provided.
Establish scientific or technical goals within those outlines.
Record the goals the manager will stand behind.

tasks.design: Broad outlines top management has already provided are listed from {DOCS}. The manager establishes the scientific or technical goals within them. An outline with no id is not listed. The list does not set the goal.
tasks.previous_blocker: The outline was requested again from top management before each goal-setting meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: An outline already provided can be listed before the manager sets the goals.
tasks.still_hard: A goal that fits the outline and still cannot be staffed.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can refuse a goal the outline allows and the team cannot carry.
tasks.altitude: Provided outlines can be listed. The manager still establishes the goals and still stands behind them.

reach.task: Read the outline top management provided, and still leave the technical goal here.
reach.learn: The outline can be listed. The goal stays here.

evidence.claim: A broad outline top management has already provided can be listed. The list cannot establish a scientific or technical goal.
The manager sets the goal. An outline is not a goal and it does not assign people.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural and engineering manager in a mid-size European firm. A list does not approve a design, place a person, or issue a contract.

Fields: Outline id, produced by the note top management already provided. An outline with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the management file the firm already keeps. Do not publish a goal from the list.
unknowns: Which outlines top management has already provided.
Which goals need a staff the firm does not have.
research_questions: What share of goal meetings start from a provided outline?
Which goals are set with no written outline?

already_counted.description: The manager still establishes the goals.
The manager still records the goals.

incremental.description: The manager asks for an outline the file did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing broad outlines top management has already provided. It disappears when the outline is missing and the manager asks for it. Establishing the goals stays with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List open project posts the manager has already approved.
Direct recruitment and placement of the project staff.
Direct evaluation of the architecture or engineering staff.

tasks.design: Open project posts the manager has already approved are listed from {PROJECT}. The manager directs recruitment, placement, and evaluation of architecture or engineering staff. A post with no id is not listed. The list does not place anyone and it stores no score.
tasks.previous_blocker: Open posts were restated from memory, and evaluation notes were kept in a private file.
tasks.enabler_now: A post the manager has already approved can be listed before recruitment starts.
tasks.still_hard: A candidate the list cannot describe, and an evaluation that is about the work and not a trait score.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can meet a person the post list does not rank, because the list does not rank.
tasks.altitude: Approved open posts can be listed. The manager still directs recruitment, placement, and evaluation. No score of a person is stored.

reach.task: List a post a person has already approved, and still leave placement and evaluation here.
reach.learn: The post can be listed. The decision stays here.

evidence.claim: An open post the manager has already approved can be listed. The list cannot recruit, place, or evaluate a person.
Hiring and evaluation of staff must not rest on automation alone. The list stores no score of behaviour or traits, and the manager directs the decision, which the person can contest.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural and engineering manager in a mid-size European firm. A list does not approve a design, place a person, or issue a contract.

Fields: Post id, produced by a post the manager has already approved. A post that is not approved is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the post register the firm already keeps. Store no score of a candidate or a staff member. Works-council consent covers staff monitoring.
unknowns: Which posts the manager has already approved.
Which evaluations must be a conversation.
research_questions: What share of recruitment starts from an approved post?
Which placements are made with no listed post?

already_counted.description: The manager still directs recruitment and placement.

incremental.description: The manager writes a post the register did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing open posts the manager has already approved. It disappears when the post is missing and the manager writes it. Recruitment, placement, and evaluation stay with the manager. No score is used.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List expenditures for reviewing against the stored limit.
Perform administrative functions, reviewing reports, writing notes, and enforcing rules.
Release purchasing of materials or services after approving the expenditure.

tasks.design: Expenditures are listed in the {ERP} for review against a stored limit. The manager performs the administrative functions, reviews the reports, writes the notes, and enforces the rules. Purchasing of materials or services is released only for the accepted expenditure. A missing limit stops the line.
tasks.previous_blocker: Expenditures were approved from a pile, and a purchase sometimes went out before the limit was checked.
tasks.enabler_now: An expenditure with a stored limit can be listed before the manager reviews it.
tasks.still_hard: A purchase inside the limit that still breaks a project rule.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can enforce a rule the limit does not express.
tasks.altitude: Expenditures inside a stored limit can be listed. The manager still reviews them, and a purchase is released only for the accepted expenditure.

reach.task: List an expenditure against a stored limit, and release the purchase only after a person approves it.
reach.learn: The list can be shared. The approval stays here.

evidence.claim: An expenditure can be listed against a limit already stored. The list cannot review the report, enforce the rule, or release the purchase.
The purchase is released only for the expenditure the manager approved. A changed amount is not that version.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural and engineering manager in a mid-size European firm. A list does not approve a design, place a person, or issue a contract.
Fields: Expenditure id and limit, produced by the ledger. An expenditure with no limit is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Release only through the purchasing path the firm already uses. Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the engineering manager.
unknowns: Which expenditures have a stored limit.
Which purchases need a second signature.
research_questions: What share of expenditures have a stored limit?
Which purchases are refused inside the limit?

already_counted.description: The manager still reviews reports and enforces rules.

incremental.description: The manager checks an expenditure the ledger did not hold.

approvals.approved_version: expenditure version and the order ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing expenditures against a stored limit, and releasing a purchase only for the accepted expenditure. It disappears when the limit is missing and the manager checks it. Reviewing and enforcing the rules stays with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The manager still writes the engineering standard, still sets the technical goal, and still directs recruitment and evaluation. An open post can be listed. No score places a person, and a purchase is released only after the manager approves the expenditure.
reach: Education administrators keep hiring and evaluation with a person, and this job learns an open-post list is not a placement.
Loss prevention managers release a purchase only after a person approves the expenditure, and this job learns the same gate.
skills_to_grow: Direct recruitment, placement, and evaluation without a score of the person.
Approve an expenditure before the purchase is released.
role.ambitious_version: Policy dates, outlines, and open posts are listed first. Standards, goals, hiring, and expenditure approval stay with the manager.
